core.title: Emtek Saratoga Dummy Handleset with Providence Knob, Pewter Finish

text.description_html:
Emtek Saratoga Entry Door Dummy Handleset

Traditional Dummy Handleset for inactive side of double entry door. Precision engineering for durability with attractive designs.

  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backset: Standard 2-3/8"
  • Handle Top Plate Height: 4-1/2"
  • Handle Top Plate Width: 3"
  • Handle Bottom Plate Height: 3"
  • Handle Bottom Plate Width: 1-13/16"
  • Exterior projection is 2-11/16"
  • Overall Grip thickness: 1-1/4"

Features for Emtek Saratoga Entrance Dummy Handleset

  • Solid Forged Brass Trim
  • Pewter Finish
  • Providence Knob Interior Trim
